# v3 phase 3 (generated by tools/build_civil_war.py)
on_actions = {
	# ROOT is the winner, FROM is annexed
	on_civil_war_end = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = NSR
					FROM = { has_country_flag = NSR_loyalist_side }
				}
				country_event = { id = nsr.310 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = NSR_loyalist_side
					FROM = { tag = NSR }
				}
				news_event = { id = nsr_news.12 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
